title: Snowshoe Tour in the Lake Tahoe Mountains
includes: Knowledgeable guide trained in CPR/First Aid
Hot drinks - hot chocolate, cider or tea
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the serene beauty of Lake Tahoe’s winter landscape on a guided snowshoe adventure. Perfect for all ability levels, this tour invites you to explore peaceful alpine forests, open meadows, and panoramic ridgelines blanketed in fresh snow. Along the way, enjoy hot drinks and a light trail snack to keep you warm and energized. Your knowledgeable local guide shares fascinating insights into Tahoe’s natural and cultural history while leading you along scenic trails tailored to current snow and weather conditions. Whether you’re looking for a family friendly outing, a fun group activity, or a peaceful winter escape, this snowshoe tour offers a memorable way to connect with the Sierra Nevada’s stunning winter wilderness.

If you are a solo traveler, please call our office to check availability to join an existing group.

Please send us your lodging location at time of booking. This allows us to offer safe, scenic routes tailored to the day’s conditions.
